{{Quote|All who make war are tyrants, Jedi. Even your heart I wonder for. Do you fight for us or the agrocite?|Adaroo|<ref name="SotR">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Adaroo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] from [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] who served as leader of the [[Khormai resistance]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He assisted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]].

==Biography==
===Battle of Khorm===
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Adaroo decided to help the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] promised to free the trapped [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] and reclaim the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. Adaroo told Master Koon that his personal nemesis, [[Unger Gout]] had allied with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in order to gain more power and enslave the Khormai in the mines of [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]].

====Seek and Destroy Mission====
The Separatists controlled a climate-control station which caused the extreme storms in the planet. Adaroo, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Kloon]], Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and a squad of the [[44th Special Operations Division]] where assigned to seek and destroy the station. When they passed through a Khormai village, Adaroo stopped and noticed that some of the villagers were killed due [[File:Adaroo_Burying_the_Dead.png|thumb|left|235px|Adaroo burying his people]]to the extreme changes in weather. Adaroo mourned the lost and decided to give them a proper burial.<ref name="The Clone Wars 7">[[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]]</ref> When they were done with the funeral, they continued their mission on foot and Adaroo guided them across the vast mountains to where the station was located. On the way there, they where ambushed by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and her squad of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. After they survived the ambush, Adaroo used an [[aelid horn]] and called several [[aelid]]s to be used as mounts for him and the rest of the group. The mounts provided a faster way to cross the mountains in order to get to the climate-control station as fast as possible. Once they arrived at the station, it was successfully destroyed and the storm ceased.<ref name="The Clone Wars 8">[[The Clone Wars 8|''The Clone Wars'' 8]]</ref>

====Freeing the Khormai People====
When they reached the mines, Kit Fisto and [[Sharp]] went to destroy the guns that fired on the clone [[Transport Ship|transport ships]], while Adaroo, Plo Kloon and the other two troopers that survived, went to free the Khormai. Once inside the mines, they encountered Asajj Ventress again. Plo Kloon stayed and fought the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|dark acolyte]] and they three continued further into the mine until the Khormai prisoners were found. When all the droids that guarded the prisoners withdrew to Kit Fisto and Sharp's location, Adaroo took the opportunity and freed the Khormai people. Once the battle was over, he thanked the Jedi for the aid they provided.<ref name="The Clone Wars 9">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>
